start: Assay offices in {system} report a rich new seam. Claim stakes are going fast.
{faction} opens {system} to prospectors after a major ore strike.
Spacer rumour: a hauler cleared a year's pay from one hold of ore at {system}. Everyone is heading there.
ongoing: Drills, pumps and crew rations are short in {system}. Ore prices keep falling as the belts fill.
Claim disputes multiply in {system} as the rush continues, says {faction}.
Bulletin: {system} is full. Berths cost double and the bar tabs are worse.
end: The big seam at {system} has thinned. Prospectors are drifting away.
{faction} closes new claims in {system}. The rush is over.
Rumour has it the {system} strike was half salted. Nobody is admitting to buying in.

start: Traffic through {system} is up by half, says {faction}. Docking queues are forming.
Trade bulletin: new contracts signed at {system}. Every hold in the district is spoken for.
{faction} cuts port dues at {system} and the freighters pour in.
ongoing: Warehouse space at {system} is scarce. Buyers are paying well for anything that arrives.
{faction} reports record tonnage through {system} for a third week.
Bulletin: dockhands at {system} are on double shifts and still behind.
end: Traffic at {system} eases to normal. The boom has run its course.
{faction} restores standard port dues at {system}.
Trade bulletin: margins at {system} are back to ordinary.

start: Exchange at {system} suspends trading after a sharp fall. {faction} urges calm.
Bulletin: three trading houses at {system} have failed. Buyers are staying home.
Spacer rumour: nobody at {system} will honour a credit chit this week.
ongoing: Luxury goods are piling up unsold at {system}. Factors are offering terms.
{faction} guarantees deposits at {system}, but few believe it.
Bulletin: cargo contracts at {system} are being cancelled in bulk.
end: Trading resumes at {system}. Prices are low but steady.
{faction} declares the {system} exchange sound again.
Bulletin: {system} buyers are back and hunting bargains.

start: Fuel depots at {system} are running dry, says {faction}. Rationing begins at once.
Bulletin: refinery fire at {system}. Tankers diverted elsewhere.
Spacer rumour: don't land at {system} unless you can leave on what you've got.
ongoing: Fuel queues at {system} stretch for hours. Black market prices keep rising.
{faction} limits fuel sales to essential traffic at {system}.
Bulletin: ships are being stranded at {system} with empty tanks.
end: Fuel tankers reach {system}. Rationing is lifted.
{faction} reopens the refinery at {system}.
Bulletin: {system} pumps are flowing again. Prices fall back.

start: Dockworkers at {system} walk out over pay. {faction} calls the action illegal.
Bulletin: strike at {system}. Cranes are idle and holds are sealed.
Spacer rumour: the {system} dockers want hazard pay and mean it.
ongoing: Ships queue at {system} with nobody to unload them. Pickets hold the gates.
{faction} threatens to bring in synth labour at {system}. Talks stall.
Bulletin: perishables are spoiling in holds at {system}.
end: Strike at {system} ends with a pay deal. Cranes are moving again.
{faction} and the dockers settle at {system} after a long argument.
Bulletin: pickets gone from {system}. Backlog expected for a week.

start: Food shortages reported in {system} as #cause#.
{faction} declares a food emergency in {system}.
Spacer rumour: the grain stores at {system} are empty and nobody will say so.
ongoing: Ration queues lengthen in {system}. Food prices have #risen#.
Relief convoys still needed in {system}, says {faction}.
Bulletin: hungry crowds outside the {system} grain office. Guards doubled.
end: Food supplies in {system} recover after weeks of shortage.
{faction} lifts the food emergency in {system}.
Bulletin: the first full grain freighter in a month docks at {system}.
cause: crop blight spreads through the farm domes
a supply convoy fails to arrive

start: {faction} reports a fever outbreak in {system}. Docks are under quarantine.
Bulletin: medical wards at {system} are full. Ships are being turned away.
Spacer rumour: don't breathe the air at {system}. Not for a while.
ongoing: Quarantine holds at {system}. Medicine is rationed and prices are climbing.
{faction} asks for doctors and filters for {system}.
Bulletin: crews are paid triple to unload at the {system} quarantine ring.
end: {faction} lifts the quarantine at {system}. The fever has burned out.
Bulletin: docks at {system} reopen. Medical stores are bare.
Spacer rumour: {system} is clean again, and everyone there is very tired.

start: Main reactor at {system} has scrammed. {faction} is running on batteries.
Bulletin: power failing across {system}. Engineers wanted at any rate.
Spacer rumour: the {system} reactor was overdue a service by about nine years.
ongoing: Rolling blackouts at {system}. Spare coils and fuel rods fetch any price.
{faction} appeals for reactor parts at {system}.
Bulletin: {system} habitats are on emergency heat. Crews are working in shifts.
end: Power restored at {system}. {faction} thanks the engineers.
Bulletin: reactor at {system} back online. Nobody is trusting it yet.
Lights on again at {system}. The parts shortage may take longer.

start: Solar flare hits {system}. Navigation and comms are down, warns {faction}.
Bulletin: all traffic at {system} grounded until the radiation falls.
Spacer rumour: the sun at {system} sneezed and took every sensor with it.
ongoing: Radiation levels at {system} remain high. Burned-out sensors are in demand.
{faction} advises shielded transit only at {system}.
Bulletin: ships at {system} are flying blind and paying for the privilege.
end: Radiation at {system} drops to safe levels. Traffic resumes.
{faction} lifts the flare warning for {system}.
Bulletin: repair yards at {system} report a month of backlog.

start: Hull breach at a ring habitat in {system}. {faction} is evacuating the lower decks.
Bulletin: decompression disaster at {system}. Rescue ships called for.
Spacer rumour: a seam gave way at {system} and the repair budget was spent on a statue.
ongoing: Hull plate and sealant are scarce at {system}. Survivors are housed in cargo bays.
{faction} orders safety inspections across {system}. Contractors are overwhelmed.
Bulletin: {system} repair crews are working round the clock.
end: {faction} declares the {system} habitat sealed and safe.
Bulletin: displaced residents return to {system}. Claims are still pending.
Rebuilding at {system} is done. The plate, they say, is thicker now.

start: {faction} calls an election at {system}. Posters cover every bulkhead.
Bulletin: polls open at {system}. Expect delays at every dock.
Spacer rumour: the {system} vote has been decided already. Only the count is left.
ongoing: Rallies fill the concourses of {system}. Printing and data brokers are busy.
{faction} deploys observers at {system} polling stations.
Bulletin: ballot disputes at {system}. Lawyers are in demand.
end: Results declared at {system}. {faction} accepts the outcome, mostly.
Bulletin: new administration sworn in at {system}. Tariffs under review.
The {system} election is over. The losers say they will be back.

start: Troops have seized the administration at {system}. {faction} is not answering calls.
Bulletin: gunfire in the {system} government quarter. Ports sealed.
Spacer rumour: the old guard at {system} woke up one morning and found the new guard in their chairs.
ongoing: Curfew at {system}. Arms dealers are doing well and everyone else is not.
{faction} denounces the junta at {system} and waits for allies.
Bulletin: ships leaving {system} are being searched twice.
end: The new regime at {system} announces itself stable. Ports reopen.
{faction} restores order at {system}. The old ministers are not seen.
Bulletin: {system} pays its first port dues to the new government.

start: {faction} has two heirs and one throne at {system}. Courts are in uproar.
Bulletin: the late head of {faction} left conflicting wills. {system} divides.
Spacer rumour: both heirs at {system} are hiring. Neither is paying on time.
ongoing: Lawyers and retainers crowd {system}. Private guards are in demand.
{faction} offices at {system} are now split down the corridor.
Bulletin: contracts at {system} are frozen until someone is confirmed in charge.
end: {faction} settles its succession at {system}. One claimant is abroad on pressing business.
Bulletin: coronation at {system}. Guests are asked to disregard the previous ceremony.
The dispute at {system} ends in a marriage, a payment and a long silence.

start: {faction} and {rival} sign a treaty at {system}. Border patrols stand down.
Bulletin: peace declared between {faction} and {rival}. {system} to host the first joint market.
Spacer rumour: {faction} and {rival} shook hands at {system}. Nobody is sure who blinked.
ongoing: Cargo between {faction} and {rival} flows through {system} at last. Arms prices are slumping.
Joint patrols from {faction} and {rival} cruise past {system}. They are polite.
Bulletin: tariff schedules at {system} rewritten for the new peace.
end: The treaty between {faction} and {rival} lapses at {system}. Both blame the other.
Bulletin: peace between {faction} and {rival} holds, and {system} gets quiet again.
The border at {system} becomes ordinary, which is how treaties are meant to end.

start: {faction} announces an embargo on {rival} goods at {system}. Cargo inspections begin.
Bulletin: no {rival} cargo may enter {system}. Customs officers are doubling up.
Spacer rumour: the embargo at {system} has a hole in it, and it is exactly ship sized.
ongoing: Banned goods fetch triple at {system}. Customs patrols are thick.
{faction} seizes another {rival} freighter near {system}.
Bulletin: smugglers at {system} are said to be making a fortune and a few enemies.
end: {faction} lifts the embargo on {rival} at {system}. Customs queues shrink.
Bulletin: embargo ends at {system}. The smugglers are looking for new work.
The ban on {rival} goods at {system} is over, and the {system} bars are quieter for it.

start: Demonstrators at {system} demand independence from {faction}. Garrison is on alert.
Bulletin: the {system} assembly votes to secede from {faction}.
Spacer rumour: {system} has a new flag, and nobody can agree on the colours.
ongoing: {faction} tightens its grip on {system}. Banned pamphlets sell for a premium.
Volunteers drill on the docks at {system}. Gun runners are welcome, no questions.
Bulletin: customs checks at {system} now ask which flag you serve.
end: {faction} grants {system} self rule. Both sides claim a victory.
Bulletin: the {system} movement is crushed. {faction} keeps the garrison.
Independence at {system} is recognised by {faction}. Port dues get complicated.

start: {faction} and {rival} trade notes over the boundary near {system}. Patrols reinforced.
Bulletin: {faction} survey ships found in {rival} space at {system}.
Spacer rumour: both {faction} and {rival} claim {system}, and both have the guns to say so.
ongoing: Warships from {faction} and {rival} shadow each other at {system}. Charter rates are up.
Border checks at {system} delay every hold.
Bulletin: a {faction} patrol fired a warning shot at {system}. {rival} fired two.
end: {faction} and {rival} agree a survey line at {system}. Marker buoys go up.
Bulletin: the {system} dispute goes to arbitration. Patrols withdraw.
Nobody at {system} seems to have won, which is considered a fair result.

start: Raiders hit three outposts near {system}. {faction} promises a response.
Bulletin: convoy escorts required at {system}. Insurance rates doubled.
Spacer rumour: the raiders around {system} know your cargo before you do.
ongoing: Raids continue near {system}. {faction} patrols are stretched thin.
Escort contracts are paying well at {system}. Several captains haven't come back.
Bulletin: another hauler lost near {system}. Survivors report no markings.
end: {faction} destroys a raider base near {system}. Insurers cut their rates.
Bulletin: raids at {system} stop as suddenly as they began.
The raiders near {system} have moved on, spacers say. Somebody else's problem now.

start: {faction} warships close the gates at {system}. {rival} traffic is turned back.
Bulletin: {system} is blockaded. No cargo in, no cargo out.
Spacer rumour: {faction} says it is an inspection drive. The guns say otherwise.
ongoing: The blockade at {system} tightens. Supplies are thin and runners are well paid.
{faction} stops another freighter at {system}. The crew are held.
Bulletin: shelves at {system} are emptying. Blockade runners are asking for danger money.
end: {faction} withdraws its fleet from {system}. The gates reopen.
Bulletin: blockade at {system} lifted after talks with {rival}.
Cargo floods into {system} as the blockade ends. The warehouses are not ready.

start: {faction} declares war on {rival}. {system} lies on the front.
Bulletin: fleets engaged at {system}. {faction} claims first blood.
The 3rd Fleet of {faction} broke at {system} despite a daring strike on {rival}'s carrier.
ongoing: Fighting continues at {system}. Both sides want hulls, ammunition and anyone with a gun.
{faction} calls up reserves at {system}. {rival} does the same.
Bulletin: casualty lists from {system} grow. The medical ships cannot keep up.
end: {faction} and {rival} agree a ceasefire at {system}. The dead are counted.
Bulletin: war ends at {system}. {faction} keeps the station, {rival} keeps its grudge.
Armistice signed at {system}. Arms prices fall by half overnight.

start: Pirate fleet reported near {system}. {faction} warns all traffic.
Bulletin: three freighters missing off {system}. Wreckage points to a pirate wing.
Spacer rumour: the pirates around {system} have a flagship and a printed tariff.
ongoing: Convoys at {system} wait days for an escort. Bounties are up.
{faction} offers a reward for the pirate captain at {system}.
Bulletin: pirates at {system} took a luxury liner last night. They returned the band.
end: {faction} breaks the pirate fleet at {system}. Traffic resumes.
Bulletin: pirate surge at {system} fades. Rumour says a bigger buyer hired them away.
The pirate flagship at {system} was found drifting and empty. Nobody is asking too hard.

start: Mercenaries have taken the station at {system}, claiming unpaid wages from {faction}.
Bulletin: contract company mutinies at {system}. {faction} refuses to negotiate.
Spacer rumour: nobody at {system} has been paid since the spring and the guns were never handed back.
ongoing: The mutineers at {system} hold the docks. Supplies get through at a price.
{faction} considers sending marines to {system}. Cheaper to pay, say the clerks.
Bulletin: bargaining at {system} goes on. Both sides say the other is being unreasonable.
end: {faction} pays the arrears at {system}. The mercenaries ship out.
Bulletin: marines retake the station at {system}. Few mercenaries survive.
The {system} uprising ends with a signed contract, a big cheque and no apologies.

start: {faction} launches a security sweep at {system}. Hold scans on every dock.
Bulletin: patrols at {system} are boarding without notice.
Spacer rumour: customs at {system} are meeting a quota and you look like part of it.
ongoing: Fines and seizures rise at {system}. Contraband prices climb with the risk.
{faction} posts new wanted lists at {system}.
Bulletin: {system} jail is full. The courts have a queue.
end: {faction} ends the sweep at {system}. Patrols go back to normal.
Bulletin: security at {system} relaxed after the quota was met.
The crackdown at {system} is over. The back-room bars are open again.

start: {faction} declares a general amnesty at {system}. Old warrants are void.
Bulletin: pardons offered at {system} to anyone who walks in and signs.
Spacer rumour: the {system} amnesty is a trick to find who's still out there.
ongoing: Fugitives line the registry office at {system}. Bounty hunters are not pleased.
{faction} lists the crimes that remain outside the amnesty at {system}. The list is long.
Bulletin: {system} bars are busy with people who used to avoid them.
end: The amnesty at {system} closes. {faction} resumes arrests.
Bulletin: amnesty ended at {system}. Those who didn't sign are on the new list.
{faction} says the {system} amnesty was a success. Nobody argues.

description: News lines for synth registry sweep.

start: {faction} orders every synth in {system} to present for registry checks.
Bulletin: synth registration drive at {system}. Unlicensed minds will be held.
Spacer rumour: they are scanning synths at {system} and nobody will say what they're looking for.
ongoing: Synth crews at {system} are being held at the docks. Shipowners want replacements.
{faction} detains a hundred synths at {system} for further checks.
Bulletin: registration offices at {system} are overrun. The synths wait very patiently.
end: The registry sweep at {system} ends. {faction} says no irregularities were found.
Bulletin: synths released at {system} after checks. Some did not return to their ships.
{faction} closes the {system} registry drive and refuses to publish the figures.

description: News lines for gate warden inspection drive.

start: Gate wardens at {system} announce a rim tech inspection drive. Every hold will be opened.
{faction} backs the warden sweep at {system}. The Lantern Synod is pleased.
Bulletin: all vessels at {system} subject to deep scan. Delays expected.
ongoing: Wardens at {system} seize another cargo of unlicensed salvage.
{faction} offers a reward for tips on rim cargo at {system}.
Bulletin: scans at {system} take hours. Salvage buyers have gone quiet.
end: The warden drive at {system} ends. Seizures are listed as significant.
Bulletin: gate scans at {system} return to normal.
The wardens leave {system} with their scanners and two sealed crates.

start: Survey crews report an incident near {system}. {faction} will not describe it.
Bulletin: all traffic beyond {system} advised to turn back. No reason given.
Spacer rumour: something happened out past {system} and the people who saw it are not talking.
ongoing: {faction} restricts rim passage from {system}. Salvagers go anyway.
Strange reports from beyond {system} continue. Nobody has proof.
Bulletin: ships leaving {system} for the rim are paid double and trusted half.
end: {faction} lifts the rim advisory at {system}. No explanation is offered.
Bulletin: the incident near {system} is declared closed.
The rim traffic at {system} resumes. The crews that went out first have not been back.

description: News lines for ships going quiet.

start: Four ships have stopped reporting on the {system} route. {faction} is investigating.
Bulletin: freighter lost contact near {system}. Search under way.
Spacer rumour: ships keep going quiet past {system}, and the quiet ones are the lucky ones.
ongoing: Insurers at {system} refuse cover for the rim route. Convoys are forming.
Search ships from {faction} find nothing near {system}.
Bulletin: another call goes unanswered on the {system} lane.
end: Traffic on the {system} route resumes. Two lost ships return, with no log.
Bulletin: {faction} closes its inquiry at {system}.
The quiet on the {system} lane has lifted. Spacers don't trust it.

description: News lines for elder machine stirring.

start: Sensors at {system} detect power in a machine that has been cold since before records.
Bulletin: {faction} scientists report movement inside the old works at {system}.
Spacer rumour: the old thing at {system} turned its head. Nobody is going back to check.
ongoing: Scholars and scrap dealers converge on {system}. {faction} sets a cordon.
Readings at {system} keep changing. {faction} insists there is no danger.
Bulletin: strange lights over the dead works at {system}.
end: The machine at {system} goes dark again. {faction} reopens the site.
Bulletin: nothing found at {system}. The cordon is lifted.
The old works at {system} sleep. The cordon has gone, the questions haven't.

start: A repeating signal has been logged at {system}. {faction} cannot place its source.
Bulletin: listeners at {system} report a pattern no one has decoded.
Spacer rumour: the {system} signal sounds like counting.
ongoing: Data brokers at {system} pay well for fresh recordings.
{faction} denies the {system} signal is important.
Bulletin: cryptographers at {system} fail again. The signal repeats.
end: The signal at {system} stops without warning. Recordings are selling anyway.
Bulletin: {faction} declares the {system} signal a natural effect.
Nothing on the {system} bands for six days. The listeners are still listening.

description: News lines for refugee wave from the rim.

start: Refugee ships from the rim arrive at {system}. {faction} sets up reception camps.
Bulletin: hundreds of families docked at {system}, saying only that they had to leave.
Spacer rumour: the people arriving at {system} won't say what they were running from.
ongoing: {faction} struggles to feed and house the arrivals at {system}. Volunteers are welcome.
Wardens at {system} screen every arrival. The queue runs for days.
Bulletin: relief cargo at {system} is in short supply. Charity ships are making runs.
end: {faction} resettles the last refugees from {system}. The camps close.
Bulletin: arrivals at {system} drop to a trickle.
The rim ships stopped coming to {system}. The last captains said the road behind them was empty.
